item.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam: The Man Who Defined His Age
item.description: The life and ideas of Erasmus of Rotterdam: from illegitimate son of a priest to the intellectual arbiter of Europe. A close reading of The Praise of Folly, the dispute with Luther on free will, and Soviet reception.
